notes.title: THE GATEWAY UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h3]Good day Rollers! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/006d80506d0466a86aff7350ddf748a8a3aa5916.png[/img]

A new update is... is... adequately and accordingly rolling in! 
[i](Getting old...)[/i]

The main goal of this update is to improve the first 10 minutes of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/8bfdb3e343c206075ac910073056ad0c28868fff.png[/img]

[h2]NEW[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Amber’s Descent[/b]: A new Introductory Sequence is now integrated into the campaign.
[*][b]Library:[/b] Both this new intro and the second animation “Spiral of darkness” can be accessed from the library if seen once.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/3fcf5ab1fcc7c71617337ea403cef36bb90c8329.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Introduction Part 2 “Spiral of Darkness”:[/b] Cut its length by 30 seconds.
[*][b]”Forging Beginners” Tutorial:[/b] Changed the lighting to be more colorful and atmospheric.

[*][b]Folk Forgotten:[/b] The two new music tracks now loop nicely.
[*][b]Level:[/b] Reverted skybound to the non-christmas version.
[*]Updated sprite for The Entertainer.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/8bfdb3e343c206075ac910073056ad0c28868fff.png[/img]

[list]

[*]Fixed an issue where the avatar would fall through Amber’s Light floor on a first playthrough.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/3fcf5ab1fcc7c71617337ea403cef36bb90c8329.png[/img]

[h2]BECOME A ROLLER TOO[/h2]
[i]we be bouncin'[/i]

notes.title: FOLK FORGOTTEN UPDATE - NEW REALM AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
[h2][i]HEARKEN, YE ENCHANTED SOULS, UNTO THE MYSTICAL REALM OF AMBERIAL DREAMS...[/i][/h2]
[i]Where unfathomed adventures await![/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/3fcf5ab1fcc7c71617337ea403cef36bb90c8329.png[/img]

[h1]BOUNCE INTO A NEW REALM[/h1]

Cast aside the veil of ordinary reality, for behold, a new update unveils itself: "Folk Forgotten," a tale of ancient myths, hardcore levels and long-lost legends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/2f5afa4976e8a8eb190bae925e32ec34742d505c.png[/img]

With this major update, you will be able to:
[list]
[*]Discover a whole new world: Folk Forgotten
[*]Uncover 16 new levels & 3 extremely hard levels in the Spire of Trials
[*]Unveil new environments and music
[*]Try many new pieces in the Atelier[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/8bfdb3e343c206075ac910073056ad0c28868fff.png[/img]

[h2]NEW[/h2]
[list]
[*]Amber’s Descent: The structure for the Folk Forgotten Realm has been added
[*]Amber’s Descent: Ambers Light intro area has revamped lighting and new decorations
[*]Amber’s Descent: Added surge margins throughout the overworld to make it harder to fall off the world inconveniently
[*]Amber’s Descent: Folk Forgotten NPCs have been discovered
[*]Amber’s Descent: Overworld areas can now change the lighting intensity and colour, this leads to more ambience and customization per realm[/list] 
[h3][b]New Levels[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Levels: Added all Folk Forgotten Levels (16)
[*]Levels: 3 New extremely hard levels from Shallot God have arrived at the Spire of Trials[/list]
[h3][b]New Environments[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Environments: New environment with new Music (Unearthed & Manifestation by Ida Jazayeri)[/list] 
[h3][b]New Pieces[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Pieces: Added Hot Rocks Variants
[*]Pieces: New decorative Ruined Columns
[*]Pieces: New decorative Trees
[*]Pieces: New Pendant Lamp Variant
[*]Piece: Nebulosi (a chaser destroyer with a more complex behaviour than the wraiths/jellyfish)
[*]Piece: Lift with configurable speed and max distance
[*]Piece: Popable bubble with configurable hit points
[*]Piece: Folk Forgotten colorless brick wall (and blurred deco variant).
[*]Pieces: Five more rocks with loose option
[*]Pieces: Added 3 more grass hill shapes[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/3fcf5ab1fcc7c71617337ea403cef36bb90c8329.png[/img]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*]Visual Art: Improved sprites for Amber, Dew, Prism, Librarian, Custodian, Niece and Uncle!
[*]Optimization: Folk Forgotten area will not activate / load from other reals to save performance
[*]Amber’s Descent: Added a little pop-up to tell players that they can enable assists.
[*]Amber’s Descent: Folk Forgotten dialogue improvements (Amber's rush, Prism in cage)
 
[*]Pieces: show lift activation area in editor
[*]Pieces: removed obsolete variant “dull arrow”
[*]Pieces: Normal bubbles now have faces that blink when hit. Their highlight is now always on top
 
[*]Levels: Primordial dream 2000 has been redecorated
[*]Levels: Updated Unwelcome and added to Folk Forgotten
[*]Levels: Updated Boxed In and added to Folk Forgotten
[*]Levels: Updated Equity and A Dark Alley (visuals only)

[*]Atelier: Block arrow buttons from moving the camera when the level properties panel is active
[*]Atelier: Duplicate shortcut has changed to Ctrl + D and uses the copy logic to avoid some bugs.

[*]Environments: Melatonin: fixed components and added depth[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/8bfdb3e343c206075ac910073056ad0c28868fff.png[/img]

[h2]FIXED[/h2]
[list][*]Pieces:  Switch areas no longer activate in the editor with loose pieces.
[*]Hall of Portals: “My Levels” are now in the correct order
[*]Fixed duplicate level IDs (Tower Achievement and duplicate medals bug)
[*]Fixed Jellyfish bubbly particles
[*]Fixed a null reference issue where Rotate on Beat was missing a parent
[*]Prevented Flinger from activating while in the editor[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/3fcf5ab1fcc7c71617337ea403cef36bb90c8329.png[/img]

[h2]*SNEAK PEEK GALLERY*[/h2]

[h3][i][b]Sentinel Arena[/b][/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/2ef835a8cc3f6db62193f4f7c8f7304f43741314.png[/img]

[h3][i][b]Spiral Plunge[/b][/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/f973744c0d3e1303e8f09ef89189b574b4a130df.png[/img]

[h3][i][b]Molten Fall[/b][/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/25a0725c9b12b2d7c205c229d92d8e9ad65d1d00.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/8bfdb3e343c206075ac910073056ad0c28868fff.png[/img]

[h2]COME AND ROLL WITH US[/h2]

If you want to stay up to date, share your favourite levels or memes, or simply talk about the game and make friends, you can join us on [url=https://discord.gg/d2Jz5bhaX7]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/amberialdreams]Twitter[/url].

You will be more than welcome in our lovely and warm community of newfound and expert Rollers.

notes.title: Patch Notes 17.0.6a
notes.notes:
[h3]Gooooood day Dreamers!![/h3]

Here is a fresh batch of added, improved and fixed features and elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/8bfdb3e343c206075ac910073056ad0c28868fff.png[/img]

[h2]NEW[/h2]
[list]
[*]A new playable story transition has been added, the Descent! This happens before Amber arrives at the hub after her long slumber.
[list]
[*]This new transition also teases a few new upcoming pieces..!
[*]When coming from this transition, Amber will appear further up in the Overworld.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/d7af57884078ea1c65855d82cdda7dd38f82a619.png[/img]

[*]Magnus Splendor: this playable transition and the tutorials are now replayable from the Library instead of being scattered in the Overworld.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/3fcf5ab1fcc7c71617337ea403cef36bb90c8329.png[/img]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*]All videos have been re-encoded for higher compatibility. This has confirmed fixing Proton/Steam Deck issues, and possibly a critical bug with some people not being able to start the campaign.
[*]All Hall of Portals sections now have 10 levels (except for Featured, which keeps 7).
[*]Internal restructuring to the game flow to better accommodate the new playable sequence and future developments.
[*]Leaderboards now scale the name of long levels instead of cutting it off.
[*]The Garden's features will all be progressively integrated into the rest of the game instead of being their own separate thing.
[*]Atelier: the center grid-lines are bolder, and the whole grid now expands to 1000x1000.
[*]Exit key arrows now appear behind the game timer.
[*]Improved the thumbnail for the level Debris.
[*]Light Blocks, Crystals and Pendant Lamps can now be colored.
[*]The Evening Star difficulty label has been upgraded to Wicked. These are relative for now.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/8bfdb3e343c206075ac910073056ad0c28868fff.png[/img]

[h2]FIXED[/h2]
[list]
[*]Atelier: fixed a bug that made the panning tool bounce from the edges if the cursor was on top of a selected piece.
[*]Atelier: fixed returning to the editor after level submission.
[*]Atelier & Adventure: fixed a few endless loops due to the new navigation system.
[*]Avatars: fixed Dew Avatar not interacting with Flingers.
[*]Avatars: fixed Dew Avatar for Autumn appearing temporarily.
[*]Campaign: fixed a bug when exiting Amber's descent from the avatar area causing bad issues when returning.
[*]Pieces: the Fluff now has better bounding boxes.
[*]Pieces: suspension bridge is now longer affected by Flinger.
[*]Fixed: leaderboards still submitting on HoP levels using the Coal Avatar.
[*]Fixed: tutorial bug/crash caused by the new zoom system.
[*]Hall of Portals: fixed a critical navigation bug when moving pages.
[*]Level unlocking sound is now properly scaling with the SFX options slider.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/4b4646ca4e40a6fad88b9ea1b2a5934e3c434921.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/3fcf5ab1fcc7c71617337ea403cef36bb90c8329.png[/img]

[h2]WHO DIS?!?[/h2]

This wouldn't be a tease for an upcoming update, would it..?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/5bd8ef62326f7c4b6577d18670c4bf74bda7dca8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/8bfdb3e343c206075ac910073056ad0c28868fff.png[/img]

[h2]COME WITH US WE BE BOUNCIN'[/h2]

Hop in our [url=https://discord.gg/d2Jz5bhaX7]Discord[/url] to meet the devs, other players, & have a rolly good time!
Annnnd follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/amberialdreams]Twitter[/url] for the latest news, content and memes!

Join the community! We'll be more than happy to welcome you in.

[h3]Have a great week everyone! ♥[/h3]

notes.title: CHRISTMAS UPDATE - AVAILABLE NOW
notes.notes:
[h3]Dreamers![/h3]

[i]What a bright time, it’s the right time
To roll the night away
Jingle bell time is a swell time
To go bouncin' in an Amberial update[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/170f20ee4b16f9334e7b4ec5f48b5ab329d0cc23.png[/img]

As you might have guessed already by the many subtle hints - it's Christmas time in Amberial Dreams!
So, really, it's AmberMas..!

[i][b]Disclaimer[/b]: in no event shall we, the Amberial Dreams team, be liable to the player's facepalming to our puns or shaking their head - however we shall taketh the chuckles and smiles.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/8bfdb3e343c206075ac910073056ad0c28868fff.png[/img]

[h2]NEW[/h2]
[list]
[*]New AmberMas Avatars: you can now play as a bauble or piece of coal

[i][b]Important note:[/b][/i] playing using these avatars won't qualify your times in the leadeboard, and the coal one modifies the gameplay as its physics is different - so you *might* not be able to finish all levels with it :D

[*]Skybound (AmberMas version) by Ethbar is now in Amber's light
[*]New AmberMas Song
[*]New AmberMas Environment
[*]Pieces can now be transparent
[*]New fixture piece: Bridge with Railing
[*]During normal gameplay, the camera will now zoom out based on the player's speed[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/3fcf5ab1fcc7c71617337ea403cef36bb90c8329.png[/img]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*]Hall of Portal levels now have the initial Title / Par time animation  
[*]Non-hold Flingers can now launch all loose objects
[*]Strengthened the Twinkle Drift bounding surges
[*]The lights inside crystals now beat in rhythm
[*]Updated Ambtris level
[*]Light Blocks, Crystals and Pendant Lamps can now be colored
[*]Removed blue lines that sometimes appear when finishing a level[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/8bfdb3e343c206075ac910073056ad0c28868fff.png[/img]

[h2]FIXED[/h2]
[list]
[*]Level names now have a max length of 50 characters
[*]Level descriptions with only blank characters are not allowed anymore
[*]Rails no longer undo gravity switchers
[*]Lasers can now be placed on paths again
[*]Fixed menu pause fade to black animation[/list]

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES[/h2]
[list]
[*]The restart/rhythm bug is still there in the Voidtone and Porphyry Dust environments. 
We will aim to fix it during December![/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/3fcf5ab1fcc7c71617337ea403cef36bb90c8329.png[/img]

[h2]*NEW AMBERMAS AVATARS*[/h2]
[i]served with pastiche Christmas song quotes[/i]

[i]He sees you when you’re playing, he knows when you’re in game, he knows when you’ve been bad or good, so be good, for goodness sake![/i]

[h3]BAUBLE AVATAR[/h3]
[i]Christmas Eve will find me, where the Bauble Avatar gleams. I’ll be playing Amberial for Christmas, if only in my dreams.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/b0bc67303d0e48ef37b8b6d31ce0f6d6d8575bb7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/8bfdb3e343c206075ac910073056ad0c28868fff.png[/img]

[h2]BE PART OF OUR ROLLSOME COMMUNITY[/h2]

notes.title: TWINKLE DRIFT PART II - NEW UPDATE AVAILABLE

notes.title: The Editor Update is here!
notes.notes:
Version [b]0.7.0[/b] is a bold step that believes in a bright and creative future for Amberial Dreams!

We have spent most of this update's effort updating core systems, adding features to the Atelier, and creating pieces that add new ways to think about levels. In this update, I want to thank [b]inakilbss[/b] for contributing so much to the systems and the math logic that I lack.

Without rambling any longer, here is the list!

[h1]Atelier (Level Builder)[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Multi-select! Grab multiple pieces and Move, Rotate, Delete, or Duplicate them together.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/7d00f96fd178861a0c2b0fd1591fab34016f6ea1.gif[/img]

[*] Corner Scaling and better selection gizmos! (by [b]inakilbss[/b])
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/ea0e336a0acdea40e6de070aed34a47894d2f971.gif[/img]

[*] Depth sorting, so you can choose which pieces to show in front of others (with 5 layers)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/a8962f3af7139271ce4b62fcca31a15fa26b60d4.png[/img]

[*] Ability to adjust width and height of levels towards a particular direction (anchor in the level properties panel)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/89fd282c305b5144656c128e6e1f2f344ce36f27.jpg[/img]

[*] Redo

[*] New dedicated Panning Tool, with included shortcuts (Spacebar or Middle Mouse) and new cursors[
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/9883379c97dcdf98b2b96a48041e39f7ffe2277f.png[/img] 

[*] Displaying Kill limits in the editor  (by [b]inakilbss[/b])
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/34828616a3a4789c15903c730e32c7fc343c3460.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/83c619faf93c4360f83c0ff540925cafa7b71891.png[/img][/url]

[*] The environment list in the editor now shows a small thumbnail
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes and small improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the scaling of non-sliced objects, specially with the grid turned on.  (by [b]inakilbss[/b])

[*] Scaling and panning now correctly takes into account the zoom level

[*] Fixed Environment not being pre-selected in the Level Properties Panel.

[*] Increased Zoom-out limits.

[*] Allow All pieces to be rotated fully

[*] Fixed Scaling gizmo overflow bug

[*] Better top menu responsiveness
[/list]

[h1]Pieces[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sparklebugs (flashing, rollable, interactable)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/c89e60a7975a14af3e17d115aaa664e5741fc97d.gif[/img]

[*] Disappearable
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/b0b4d35e80be3f3f7a9abc1475f5d994bb99f442.jpg[/img]

[*] Surges that pull instead of push

[*] Decorative arrows, can be resized
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/7b2ebc35fc39fe6e3cb0e92d3570cbdd72978edf.jpg[/img]

[*] Springs are now fully rotateable! (by [b]inakilbss[/b]), for that sweet 360 degree spring action[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/ef415274577afe3fc691890233c0a64ca6b34b8b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: July 2020 Development Update
notes.notes:
[h3]We have a new trailer![/h3]
[previewyoutube=tjlwEFpqzTM;full][/previewyoutube]
It showcases the near-final graphics, the new HUB, updated environments and a better multiplayer camera. Screenshots on the steam page have been updated too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/f04e67a5bbcdaed8068b0ec73fc7407d2989ccc0.png[/img]

We also just started a Discord server which you can join here:
https://discord.gg/HnJ2qhZ
[b]If you are interested in playing and providing feedback for the beta version, please roll in and let us know.
[/b]
The Hub menu system is done, and is now a fully playable environment. 
Since I was a child, I had a particular fascination with Mario overworlds such as the castle in Super Mario 64, or the map in Super Mario World. Being able to move around, explore, and inhabit the game spaces allows for more playfulness and opportunities for imagination.

Now we will be working on refining the multiplayer system and player progression.

There has been some delays, but the development roadmap is now updated too:
https://trello.com/b/zHJZ8k2q/amberial-dreams

--Cuauhtemoc "oddgoo" Moreno

notes.title: November 2019 Development Update
notes.notes:
Development has been ramping up in the past couple of months!
After finishing a reworking of the Level Builder systems and UI, goals have flown a lot better.


Here is a summary of the progress:
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/0578527215966ef73616c097f9d9490f9a9654dc.gif[/img]
[*]Rhythmical and musical elements now have a unified system. Everything will work automatically based on positions and the level environment

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/a50f8d33a87804d93e593fdaca86a831165e6a65.png[/img]
[*]The Level Builder now has a new alternative piece menu to select between different options

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/1a0b55b3db08f3a7ec6fd61d9eed432a371ac7f1.png[/img]
[*]Finished a pretty cool capture and thumbnail system for displaying adventure and custom levels

[*]An initial selection of level environments with custom lighting and post processing effects

[*]Upgraded the Unity engine to 2019.3 and the Universal Rendering Pipeline

[*]A few new pieces such as a no gravity zone, and prettier brick grounds

[*]Lots of little improvements and fixes on the User Interface

[*]New sounds and effects across a lot of pieces and elements

[*]Sounds and effects across everything

[*]Working on the base multiplayer systems

[/list]

At this stage, we're still deciding on an Early Access release, and what would that represent. The next major things to work on are music, finishing the base multiplayer system, and finishing the initial bundle of levels.

Thanks everyone who wishlisted and is following this! We are pretty excited to continue.

- Cuauhtemoc "oddgoo" Moreno

notes.title: August 2019 Update
notes.notes:
After much testing and thinking, the game is now on the final track to finalising most of the important design decisions, clearing the way for easier progress.

These were questions such as:
[list]
[*] How to best organize the menus and user flows?
[*] What happens when a player gets eliminated in co-op multiplayer?
[*] How much of the level backgrounds should we prepopulate?
[*] How should the camera react to the level bounds?
[*] etc. etc. etc.!
[/list]

In September I will be making the roadmap public. One of my main goals is being more communicative and open about the whole development process.

Here is some of the progress of the month:
[list]
[*] Finished upgrading to a new lighting and background system:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Y1545J7rHcluaaQsUA/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] Implemented import / export functions to the level editor

[*] Added an initial options screen, and made progress on the control system

[*] Many little graphical improvements 

[*] Almost finished with the camera systems, including zooming, staying within dynamic bounds, and showing the level bounds in the editor
[/list]

Thanks everyone who wishlisted and is following this!


- Cuauhtemoc "oddgoo" Moreno
